geometric_construction.trust_basis: Exact finite geometry and signed markings, pinned native PL transport/recognition, and the reviewed relative PL normal-neighborhood and boundary-extension theorem. A finite global normal-bundle matrix atlas is not claimed.

homology_derivation: pi1=1 gives H1=0. For the admitted connected closed oriented 4-manifold, PD/UCT give H3=0 and torsion-free H2. chi=2 forces rank H2=0.
homotopy_type_basis: The source-bound trivial fundamental group and integral homology of S4 imply homotopy equivalence to S4 by Hurewicz and the homological Whitehead theorem. This is not a PL standardization.
scope: Homotopy-sphere invariants and faithful geometric identification are separate from a standardization certificate. Failed or bounded heuristic search implies no exoticness claim.

standardization.acceptance_rule: Immutable source -> independently replayed closed PL contraction prefix -> embedded simplex puncture -> all guarded native macros replayed with exact hashes -> isomorphism to Example4.ball(), isoSig baa.
